programme.how_found: Search (site:vu.lt) 'Vilnius University bachelor computer science English taught programme Faculty of Mathematics and Informatics' -> https://mif.vu.lt/lt3/en/studies/bachelor-studies (MIF bachelor list: Informatics appears under the heading 'Bachelor studies in Lithuanian'; only Bioinformatics, Business Data Analytics and Multilingualism and Digital Technologies appear under 'Bachelor studies in English'); then search (site:mif.vu.lt) 'mif.vu.lt Informatika bakalauro studijų programa stojantiesiems' -> MIF programme page. Central VU admission page for the same programme: https://www.vu.lt/studijos/stojantiesiems/bakalauro-studiju-sarasas/informatika.
programme.notes: No English-taught bachelor in computer science / software engineering / informatics exists at the Faculty of Mathematics and Informatics. On https://mif.vu.lt/lt3/en/studies/bachelor-studies the entry reads 'Informatics ... Full-time, 4 years ... 240 credit ... Language(s) of instruction: Lithuanian/ English ... Bachelor of Computing' and 'Part of study subjects are taught in English.', grouped under 'Bachelor studies in Lithuanian' together with Software Engineering, Information System Engineering and Data Science. VU's central English list of bachelor programmes (https://www.vu.lt/en/studies/bachelor-studies) contains from MIF only Bioinformatics and Business Data Analytics; the 'Software Engineering' on that list belongs to Šiauliai Academy, not MIF. The apply.vu.lt page https://apply.vu.lt/courses/course/98-informatics titled 'Informatics' is a 2-year master's (120 ECTS, Master in Computing Sciences), not a bachelor. The Lithuanian-taught bachelor Informatika was not found on the international application system apply.vu.lt (searches; the course list itself is JavaScript-rendered). Degree: Informatikos mokslų bakalauras, 4 years, 240 credits, full-time.

value.description: Programme is taught in Lithuanian, so no IELTS/TOEFL minimum is published for it. Applicants must demonstrate sufficient Lithuanian language proficiency (Lithuanian proficiency test arranged through the Department of Lithuanian Studies, Faculty of Philology); exempt if they have passed the State Lithuanian language exam or hold a B2-level Lithuanian certificate from a competent institution.

english.quote: For admission to study programmes taught in Lithuanian, you need to demonstrate sufficient Lithuanian language proficiency.
english.notes: Recorded under 'english' because the programme is Lithuanian-taught (see programme notes). Exemption sentence on the same page: 'You are exempt from providing additional proof of Lithuanian language proficiency if you have passed the State Lithuanian language exam or you hold a B2 level certificate issued by a competent institution.' For comparison, VU's English-taught bachelor programmes require (same page): 'IELTS Academic 6.5+, TOEFL iBT 81+, Cambridge English Exam 176+, Pearson PTE Academic 59+, LanguageCert IESOL B2, Duolingo English Test 120+, Password Skills Plus 6.5+ or another language proficiency certificate equivalent to B2 CEFR'. The Senate 'Description of the Procedure for the Admission of Foreign Nationals' (PDF, wording of 22 Oct 2024) gives lower default floors for English-taught programmes 'unless otherwise specified' (IELTS Academic 5.5+, TOEFL iBT 46+); the website figures are the ones currently applied. The Lithuanian-taught Informatika curriculum includes 'Akademinė ir mokslinė anglų kalba C1' as a first-semester compulsory course.

value.description: Minimum competitive score (minimalus konkursinis balas) of 4 for applicants who obtained secondary education in 2025 or 2026, in VU's general admission (LAMA BPO) for the 2026 intake; in addition, at least three state matura exams (Lithuanian language and literature, mathematics, one of the applicant's choice) each at or above the basic achievement level, i.e. the arithmetic mean of the three results at least 50 points. The competitive score is composed of mathematics (exam, weight 0.4), IT or physics/biology/chemistry/geography/economics/engineering technologies (0.2), any other non-overlapping subject (0.2) and Lithuanian language and literature (exam, 0.2).

gpa.quote: Asmenims, vidurinį išsilavinimą įgijusiems 2025 ir 2026 metais, minimalus konkursinis balas yra 4;
gpa.how_found: Search (site:mif.vu.lt, vu.lt) 'mif.vu.lt Informatika bakalauro studijų programa stojantiesiems' -> result 'Informatika' at vu.lt/studijos/stojantiesiems/bakalauro-studiju-sarasas/informatika -> section 'Minimalieji reikalavimai'
gpa.notes: Supporting sentences on the same page: 'Išlaikyti ne mažiau kaip 3 valstybinius brandos egzaminus', 'Egzaminų rezultatai turi būti ne mažesni nei pagrindinis pasiekimų lygmuo', 'aritmetinis vidurkis turi būti nuo 50 balų'. These are the general-admission rules (2026 cycle) which, per the Senate Description §3 (PDF), also govern foreign nationals applying to Lithuanian-taught programmes; a Kazakh school-leaver's qualification must first be recognised (https://www.vu.lt/stojantiesiems/priemimo-informacija: applicants educated abroad go through SKVC or, in other cases, the chosen institution). For VU's international-admissions route (apply.vu.lt, used for English-taught programmes) no numeric threshold is published: 'Admission criteria: grades, motivation letter, English proficiency test results (for programmes taught in English) and, if applicable, work experience in the field of the chosen study programme and/or the proof of fulfilled specific programme requirements' (https://www.vu.lt/en/admissions/admissions-to-bachelor-studies). The country-specific requirements page (https://www.vu.lt/en/required-attachments) sets no grade threshold for Kazakhstan (documents: Certificate of Completed Secondary Education, Appendix, UNT or Complex Testing results; 'When the State entrance examinations are not taken or passed, the University applies a knowledge and ability test.'); thresholds exist only for other countries (e.g. Bangladesh GPA 4.50, Nepal GPA 3.2, Pakistan 75%).

deadline.how_found: Same page as gpa (search result) -> section 'Stojimo žingsniai' -> 'Pagrindinis etapas:'
deadline.notes: Only the 2026 cycle is published; the 2027 (autumn 2027 intake) dates are not yet available: https://www.vu.lt/stojantiesiems/priemimo-informacija says 'Priėmimas į bakalauro ir vientisąsias studijas 2026 m. yra pasibaigęs'. The recorded date is the end of the main stage of Lithuania's general admission (LAMA BPO) for 2026 (main stage 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-23 12:00; additional stages 2026-08-04 to 2026-08-07 12:00 and 2026-08-14 to 2026-08-17). This is the applicable route for this programme: the Senate 'Description of the Procedure for the Admission of Foreign Nationals' (https://vu.lt/uploads/EN_Translation_Uzsienio_saliu_pilieciu_aprasas_aa749645e9.pdf) §3 states 'Foreign nationals applying to study programmes where the language of instruction is Lithuanian, as well as citizens of the Republic of Lithuania who have obtained education at Lithuanian education institutions, shall be admitted following the Rules for Admission to Vilnius University Study Programmes and time limits set therein.' For VU's separate international admissions system (apply.vu.lt), which carries the English-taught programmes, the 2027/28 round is announced: 'We are currently preparing for our next major admissions round for the 2027/2028 academic year, which opens on 1 December 2026.' with deadlines 'International: 1 May' and 'EU/EFTA: 1 July' (https://apply.vu.lt/), i.e. 2027-05-01 for non-EU applicants to those programmes; the English admissions page confirms 'one intake per academic year' and the FAQ mentions 'the application deadline, the 1st of May or July'. The Lithuanian-taught bachelor Informatika was not found on apply.vu.lt, and the Lithuanian-taught MIF programme that is listed there ('Informacinės technologijos', https://apply.vu.lt/courses/course/195-informacines-technologijos) states 'Applications are accepted from the following territories (based on citizenship): Ukraine.'

value.population: state non-funded place (valstybės nefinansuojama vieta), all fee-paying entrants; no separate non-EU fee is published for this programme

tuition.how_found: Search (site:mif.vu.lt) 'mif.vu.lt Informatika bakalauro studijų programa stojantiesiems' -> MIF programme page -> 'Apie programą' box
tuition.notes: 2027/28 fees are not published. The MIF page names the year ('2025 m.'). VU's central 2026-admission page for the programme (https://www.vu.lt/studijos/stojantiesiems/bakalauro-studiju-sarasas/informatika) shows the same figure for 2026 entrants: 'Metinė studijų kaina įstojus į valstybės nefinansuojamą vietą' '4 201 EUR' (year not stated on that line). VU's tuition-fees page (https://www.vu.lt/en/students/services-for-students/finance/tuition-fees) publishes no table: 'Your tuition fee depends on your study programme and funding type.' Non-state-funded foreign applicants admitted through apply.vu.lt 'must pay the annual tuition fee within 15 calendar days from the date of the offer to study' and pay a non-refundable 100 EUR application fee (https://www.vu.lt/en/admissions/admissions-to-bachelor-studies).

value.name: Vilniaus universiteto 450-mečio stipendija (Vilnius University 450th Anniversary Scholarship) — for incoming first-year students

scholarship_exists.quote: Universiteto 450-mečio stipendija skirta pirmakursiams, siekiantiems studijuoti, net jei susiduriate su finansiniais ar socialiniais iššūkiais.
scholarship_exists.how_found: https://www.vu.lt/studijos/stojantiesiems/bakalauro-studiju-sarasas/informatika -> 'Finansavimas' -> link '450-mečio stipendija' -> scholarship page; also search (site:vu.lt) 'Vilniaus universiteto 450-mečio stipendija pirmakursiams konkursinis balas užsienio piliečiai'
scholarship_exists.notes: University-run (VU's own funds), EUR 3000 for the first year ('Stipendija yra 3000 eurų.' paid as 300 EUR/month from September to June). Applied for during the main stage of the general admission ('Paraiškų teikimas vyksta bendrojo priėmimo pagrindinio etapo metu.'; for 2026: 'iki 2026 m. liepos 23 d.'); 100 entrants with the highest admission score who meet the criteria are selected; criteria per VU Scholarship Regulations §57 (https://vu.lt/uploads/EN_Translation_Vilniaus_universiteto_stipendiju_nuostatai_1_upd_cf00c6a86a.pdf): first-year first-cycle/integrated students admitted in the current year who took part in the first stage of the general admission with the VU programme as first priority, hold no prior bachelor's/master's degree, family income per person not exceeding EUR 500/month (the 2026 web page and 25 May 2026 news item use 600 EUR), plus at least one social criterion. Other VU-published funding for incoming international bachelor applicants is limited to other units and does not cover MIF Informatika: the 'Admission Scholarship' of the Faculty of Economics and Business Administration (EUR 1,000, 30 awards) and the IIRPS tuition-fee waiver for 'Politics of Global Challenges' (https://www.vu.lt/en/all-news/study-without-financial-burden-vilnius-university-offers-a-variety-of-funding-opportunities, 24 March 2026). VU's university-wide Incentive Scholarship (one-off, 11 basic social benefits) cannot be considered at entry: the Regulations state it 'is not awarded to: students studying in the first semester'. State-funded places are closed to this applicant (only Lithuanian/EU/EFTA citizens, permanent residents and persons of Lithuanian origin).

scholarship_international.quote: Paraiškų teikimas vyksta bendrojo priėmimo pagrindinio etapo metu.
scholarship_international.how_found: Scholarship page (see scholarship_exists) plus VU Scholarship Regulations PDF linked from https://www.vu.lt/en/students/services-for-students/finance ('Vilnius University Scholarship Regulations') and two VU news items (daugiau.vu.lt 21 July 2025; www.vu.lt 25 May 2026)
scholarship_international.notes: No published sentence states whether non-Lithuanian / non-EU applicants are eligible, so true/false cannot be recorded. The page's 'Kas gali gauti šią stipendiją?' section did not render (JavaScript accordion). The Scholarship Regulations contain no citizenship criterion: §4 'Every student of the University is entitled to a scholarship provided they meet the criteria for awarding a specific scholarship set out in the Regulations.' (the only nationality-specific clause concerns exchange students under bilateral agreements), and §57.1 requires that the person 'participates in the first stage of the general admission to Lithuanian higher education institutions of the current academic year and lists the University's study programme as their first priority' — the same general-admission route the Senate Description §3 prescribes for foreign nationals applying to Lithuanian-taught programmes. The 2026 news item lists the criteria as family income per person not above 600 EUR, no prior bachelor's/master's degree, no earlier VU birthday scholarship, and VU as first choice; none mentions citizenship. A foreign applicant would additionally need the income documentation ('Pažyma apie šeimos pajamas ... už paskutinius 3 mėnesius').

access_notes: apply.vu.lt/courses (programme catalogue) is rendered client-side (template placeholders such as '{{ course.name }}' and 'No results were found' without JavaScript), so the full list of programmes open to foreign applicants could not be enumerated; targeted searches found no bachelor-level 'Informatika' there.

On https://www.vu.lt/en/admissions/admissions-to-bachelor-studies the heading 'The admissions deadline for studies starting in autumn 2027 is:' is followed by an empty hidden grid in the server-rendered HTML (date rendered client-side); the date was taken from apply.vu.lt instead.

Accordion sections did not render without JavaScript: 'Kas gali gauti šią stipendiją?' on the 450-mečio stipendija page and 'Intended for students who:' / 'Skiriama studentams, kurie:' on the incentive-scholarship pages.

The two official PDFs (Description of the Procedure for the Admission of Foreign Nationals; Vilnius University Scholarship Regulations) could not be parsed by the fetch tool; their text was extracted by streaming the official vu.lt URL through PyMuPDF (no saved local copy was read). Quotes from them may differ in whitespace from the PDF line breaks.

The 'Funding Opportunities for International Students' card on https://www.vu.lt/en/students/services-for-students/finance carried no extractable link; a guessed URL (.../finance/funding-opportunities-for-international-students) returned HTTP 404. The 24 March 2026 news article was used instead.
No login was used; no robots rules bypassed; no local project files were read.
